藏品名称_EN: perspective print depicting wan-nian qiao bridge in suzhou
描述_EN: european jesuit artists working at the chinese imperial court in the 17th and 18th centuries played an important role in introducing western painting styles to china. when a viewer looks at it through a mignifying lens of the peepbox, he or she will see the image in the right direction. interest in european perspective techniques spread to suzhou in eastern china, a centre for the production of woodblock prints to celebrate new year. images such as this, of suzhou’s wan-nian qiao bridge, were widely seen and brought western pictorial conventions to a large and varied audience. for this reason, the prints like this are printed in reverse and the inscriptions appear in back front. these perspective prints were made to be viewed through an optical device such as a peepbox incorporating a mirror.
描述_ZN: 17、18世纪在中国宫廷工作的欧洲耶稣会艺术家在向中国介绍西方绘画风格方面发挥了重要作用。 当观看者通过窥视盒的模拟镜头观看时，他或她会看到图像的正确方向。 对欧洲透视技术的兴趣传到了中国东部的苏州，那里是生产庆祝新年的木版画的中心。 像这样的苏州万年桥的图片被广泛看到，并把西方的绘画惯例带给了大量不同的观众。 由于这个原因，像这样的版画是反向印刷的，题词出现在后面的前面。 这些透视版画是为了通过光学设备，如带有镜子的窥视盒来观看。
